calls.text: {"outcome":"replied","thread_id":"t-mspie8in-err-6","reply":{"id":12,"thread_id":"t-mspie8in-err-6","from":"backend","kind":"reply","body":"Cursors are signed and expire after 24 hours; a stale or tampered one gets a 410 with code cursor_expired, distinct from the 400 for malformed input. args.body: Cursors are signed and expire after 24 hours; a stale or tampered one gets a 410 with code cursor_expired, distinct from the 400 for malformed input.
